title: select_mode_action_bar — comparison_bar's self-declared mirror — keeps the unfixed fixed-bar pattern (h-9 buttons, no wrap)
evidence: Component doc comment: "Fixed-bottom action bar that replaces the comparison bar while the //// leaderboard is in select mode. Mirrors the `comparison_bar` layout". Line 43: `[class("max-w-5xl mx-auto flex items-center justify-between gap-4")]` — the exact pre-PR comparison_bar container (now `flex flex-wrap ... gap-x-4 gap-y-1`). Line 58: `"text-sm text-slate hover:text-charcoal transition-colors h-9 px-3"`. Line 69: `"border border-score-red ... rounded-lg h-9 px-4 text-sm ..."` — both 36px, under the 44px guideline this PR enforces on comparison_bar's `min-h-[44px]` buttons.
detail: This PR fixes the fixed-bottom-bar pattern (44px targets, wrapping row) in comparison_bar only. Its documented mirror, mounted on the mobile-reachable leaderboard (leaderboard_view.gleam:163), keeps the same defect class; the mirrored pair now diverges.
recommended_fix: Apply the same flex-wrap container + min-h-[44px] inline-flex treatment to select-cancel and select-mark-rejected, or record a conscious deferral (bead) for the sibling.

title: Conflicting display utilities in mobile help link: `block` and `flex` in one class list
detail: In the generated tailwind.css, `.block` precedes `.flex` (verified in the built stylesheet), so `flex` wins and `block` is dead. Harmless today but the conflicting pair misleads future editors about the rendered display mode.
recommended_fix: Drop `block` from the class string; `flex items-center` already sets the intended display.

title: view_copy_button duplicated in distribution_strip and vacancy_handoff; this PR had to apply the identical fix twice
evidence: distribution_strip.gleam:186 `fn view_copy_button(testid: String, copied: Bool, on_click: Msg) -> Element(Msg) {` and vacancy_handoff.gleam:302 same signature; both bodies carry the identical class string updated in lockstep by this diff: `"inline-flex items-center px-3 min-h-[44px] rounded text-xs font-semibold text-navy bg-navy/10 hover:bg-navy/20 transition-colors"`.
detail: Two private copies of the same helper; this diff edited both in lockstep — the next copy-UX or tap-target change risks drifting between them. Violates the repo's DRY rule (repeat 2+ places → extract).
recommended_fix: Extract a shared copy_button component (client/src/components/) taking testid/copied/on_click and use it from both modules.

title: Terminal-roots test pins the full ordered class string rather than a distinctive token
evidence:
rejected
  |> string.contains("flex flex-col items-end gap-2 w-full")
  |> should.be_true — versus the established #631 pin style in the same file: `html |> string.contains("min-h-[44px]") |> should.be_true` (demo_banner_controls_reach_44px_test) and `string.contains("pb-28")`.
detail: Asserting the entire class list in source order breaks on any unrelated class addition or reorder while behavior is unchanged; deviates from the file's single-token pin convention.
recommended_fix: Pin distinctive tokens instead — e.g. assert the status-stepper root contains `w-full` and `items-end` separately rather than the full ordered string.
